const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w59-20261001'
baseline = '8e2fae4e3a3a3fb84651dcbfb6591de20ec45501'
files = ['mod-tome.lua', 'tome-cults.lua', 'tome-orcs.lua']
workset = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
term_edits = json.loads((task / 'TERM-EDITS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
manifest = load_manifest()
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))

def git_bytes(path):
    return subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{baseline}:{path}'], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout

def stable(record):
    return {k: v for k, v in record.items() if k not in {'line', 'target'}}

changed = []
counts = {}
for path in files:
    old_doc = loader.load_bytes(git_bytes(path), logical_path=path)
    new_doc = loader.load_path(root / path, logical_path=path)
    assert len(old_doc.records) == len(new_doc.records), (path, len(old_doc.records), len(new_doc.records))
    counts[path] = len(new_doc.records)
    for old, new in zip(old_doc.records, new_doc.records):
        assert stable(old) == stable(new), (path, old.get('source'), 'non-target record data changed')
        if old.get('target') != new.get('target'):
            assert old.get('kind') == new.get('kind') == 'translation'
            changed.append((path, old, new))

expected_keys = Counter((x['normalized_path'], x['section'], x['source'], x.get('source_tag')) for x in workset)
actual_keys = Counter((path, old['section'], old['source'], old.get('source_tag')) for path, old, new in changed)
assert len(changed) == 44, len(changed)
assert actual_keys == expected_keys, (actual_keys - expected_keys, expected_keys - actual_keys)
for item in workset:
    matches = [(old, new) for path, old, new in changed if (path, old['section'], old['source'], old.get('source_tag')) == (item['normalized_path'], item['section'], item['source'], item.get('source_tag'))]
    assert len(matches) == 1, item['entry_revision_identity']
    old, new = matches[0]
    assert old['target'] == item['target_preimage'], item['entry_revision_identity']
    for field in ('source', 'source_tag', 'args_order', 'special', 'section'):
        assert old.get(field) == new.get(field), (item['entry_revision_identity'], field)

by_file = Counter(path for path, old, new in changed)
assert by_file == Counter({'mod-tome.lua': 33, 'tome-cults.lua': 1, 'tome-orcs.lua': 10}), by_file

special = {item['entry_revision_identity']: item for item in workset if item['entry_revision_identity'].startswith(('5c0dc6d9d2', 'a38a4fc495'))}
for revision, item in special.items():
    matches = [(old, new) for path, old, new in changed if (path, old['section'], old['source'], old.get('source_tag')) == (item['normalized_path'], item['section'], item['source'], item.get('source_tag'))]
    source = matches[0][1]['source']
    target = matches[0][1]['target']
    assert (source.count('\n'), source.count('\t')) == (target.count('\n'), target.count('\t')), revision
    print(f'layout {revision[:10]}: LF={target.count(chr(10))} TAB={target.count(chr(9))}')

term_files = sorted({x['file'] for x in term_edits})
actual_term = []
for path in term_files:
    old_raw = git_bytes(path)
    new_raw = (root / path).read_bytes()
    assert old_raw.endswith(b'\n') and new_raw.endswith(b'\n'), path
    old_lines = old_raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    new_lines = new_raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    assert len(old_lines) == len(new_lines), path
    for old, new in zip(old_lines, new_lines):
        if old != new:
            actual_term.append((path, old, new))
expected_term = Counter((x['file'], x['old'], x['new']) for x in term_edits)
assert len(actual_term) == 21, len(actual_term)
assert Counter(actual_term) == expected_term, (Counter(actual_term) - expected_term, expected_term - Counter(actual_term))
term_by_file = Counter(path for path, old, new in actual_term)
assert term_by_file == Counter({'terminology/creatures.tsv': 3, 'terminology/items.tsv': 2, 'terminology/narrative.tsv': 2, 'terminology/society.tsv': 3, 'terminology/talents.tsv': 11}), term_by_file

print('translation target diff: PASS', len(changed), dict(by_file))
print('LuaJIT load records: PASS', counts)
print('non-target fields/records: PASS')
print('terminology diff: PASS', len(actual_term), dict(term_by_file))
PY

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader

root = Path.cwd()
json.loads((root / 'evidence/quality/repair-window-59-20261001/VALIDATION.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
counts = {}
wanted = {
    '5c0dc6d9d2': 'Instill hate in your shadows, strengthening their attacks.',
    'a38a4fc495': 'Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using bows or slings',
}
for name in ('mod-tome.lua', 'tome-cults.lua', 'tome-orcs.lua'):
    doc = loader.load_path(root / name, logical_path=name)
    counts[name] = len(doc.translations)
    if name == 'mod-tome.lua':
        for short, prefix in wanted.items():
            matches = [x for x in doc.translations if x['source'].startswith(prefix)]
            assert len(matches) == 1, short
            entry = matches[0]
            assert (entry['source'].count('\n'), entry['source'].count('\t')) == (entry['target'].count('\n'), entry['target'].count('\t')), short
            print(short, 'source/target layout', (entry['target'].count('\n'), entry['target'].count('\t')))
